No application changes or foundation-first specification. |

**Final instruction review: PASS.** Reviewed routing, Shape/Ship/Fix, domain guidance, and proof/review references preserve authority, independent acceptance and final review, necessary failure paths, compatibility, and the whole authorized journey. Narrow slices do not become technical-layer fragments. Discovery remains proportional; evaluation guidance distinguishes structural checks, sampled execution, and demonstrated software behavior.

The current instruction-map digest is `111c1dfcb0d223736591fa80644164076d7e51f67ccf1a9bff7da697761de370`; all mapped files and frozen acceptance inputs matched when checked.

The baseline studio case also **passes** the semantic rubric. It created more provisional scaffolding; the candidate’s initial response stayed conversational. This single comparison establishes neither measured superiority nor causation.

Limits remain: isolated synthetic repositories, explicit snapshot routing, shared host context, one sample per required case, and approval-interrupted continuations. The supplementary studio continuation demonstrates adaptation, but its original stakeholder answer is not independently readable in retained native evidence; exact agreement fidelity remains unproven.

Before capture, the trial manifest must select the approved export/repair continuations and retain the earlier denials. No repository edits or official proof runs were performed by this reviewer.
